name: stockcurve GME/SPY 0.05sh
description: stockcurve demo pool token: 1 sGME-SPY = 0.05 share-unit of a GME reference, launched on a Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve quoted in SPYx (the S&P 500 xStock) so the curve discovers GME's price relative to the index rather than in dollars. Reference anchored live to GMEx via Jupiter. Hackathon demo (Stocklana 2026), not a claim on GameStop shares.
